$comment: Single source of truth for the review checklist (brief sections 3a-3c). analyzer/build_schema.py generates the Content Understanding analyzer from it, scripts/seed-checklist.py seeds vz_checklistitem from it, and the Function maps analyzer results back to findings with it. A key is the analyzer field name and the vz_key alternate key, so never rename one. Add new items at the end.
rightSuffix: Use 'Not Addressed' if the document does not explicitly address this. Never infer from silence.

defaultJudgments.Permitted: The document explicitly allows this without material conditions.
defaultJudgments.Conditional: The document allows or requires this only under stated conditions, limits or approvals.
defaultJudgments.Not Addressed: The document does not explicitly address this. Never infer from silence.

items.label: Client / Vendor
items.definition: Legal name of the counterparty providing data or services to Vizient or its affiliate.

items.label: Vizient contracting entity
items.definition: The Vizient entity or affiliate that is a party, for example Vizient Inc. or Sg2, LLC.

items.label: Document type

enumDescriptions.MSA: Master services agreement: umbrella terms that govern later statements of work or orders.
enumDescriptions.SOW: Statement of work: scope, deliverables, term and fees for specific work.
enumDescriptions.Amendment: Amendment: changes, extends or restates an earlier agreement or statement of work.
enumDescriptions.Order Form: Order form: an ordering document for specific products, data or subscriptions.
enumDescriptions.DUA: Data use agreement: terms for access to or use of data.
enumDescriptions.BAA: Business associate agreement: HIPAA terms for handling protected health information.
enumDescriptions.Other: None of the other document types.

items.definition: Type of this document.

items.label: Contract identifier
items.definition: Agreement, SOW, opportunity or contract number of THIS document.

items.label: Effective date
items.definition: Date this document takes effect.

items.label: Expiration / end date
items.definition: Date the term or license period ends. Leave empty if evergreen or not stated.

items.label: Renewal & termination terms
items.definition: Summary of renewal terms, notice periods and termination-for-convenience rights. Empty if not stated. A one-time extension or change of the end date is not a renewal term.

items.label: Signatories
items.definition: Names, titles and signature dates of all signers.

items.label: Parent / related agreement
items.definition: Any other agreement this document incorporates by reference, amends or is governed by, with number and date. Empty if none. Only a specific agreement the document names counts; a statement that the document is stand-alone is not a reference.

items.label: Internal Analytics
items.definition: May the data be used for internal reporting and analysis?

items.label: AI / Machine Learning
items.definition: May the data be used for AI/ML model training or inference?

items.label: Product Development
items.definition: May the data be used in commercial products, solutions, or derivative works?

items.label: BAA Required
items.definition: Does the contract require or reference a Business Associate Agreement?

judgments.Conditional: The contract requires or references a Business Associate Agreement.
judgments.Not Addressed: The contract does not mention a Business Associate Agreement.

items.label: Retention Requirements
items.definition: How long may data be retained? What retention obligations apply?

items.label: Affiliate Sharing
items.definition: May data be shared with corporate affiliates?

items.label: Third-Party Sharing
items.definition: May data be distributed or disclosed to external parties/clients?

items.label: Data Linking
items.definition: May data be combined/linked with other datasets? Any limits on identifiers/linkages?

items.label: De-Identification Rights
items.definition: May data be anonymized, aggregated, or de-identified, and used afterward?

items.label: Destruction Requirements
items.definition: What must happen to the data at termination/expiration (return, destroy, archive)?

items.label: Geographic / Offshore
items.definition: Does the contract limit where the data may be stored or accessed from, for example data residency, United States-only storage or access, or an offshore access rule?

judgments.Permitted: The contract expressly allows the data to be stored or accessed from any location, including offshore.
judgments.Prohibited: The contract itself limits storage or access to the United States or another named location, or forbids offshore storage or access.
judgments.Conditional: The contract allows storage or access outside the stated location only with approval or under stated conditions.
judgments.Not Addressed: The contract states no rule on where the data is stored or accessed from. Never infer from silence.

items.label: Contract Owner
items.definition: Vizient business owner of this contract. Assigned by a person, not read from the document.

items.label: Legal Reviewer
items.definition: Legal reviewer assigned to this contract. Assigned by a person, not read from the document.
